blocks.text: BSU actively develops international cooperation in the field of education, science and culture. To date, the university has signed more than 70 partnership agreements with leading universities from Russia, China, South Korea, Japan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Azerbaijan, Germany, Poland, Turkey, Cyprus, Thailand, Iran, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia and other countries.
The University cooperates with both national universities and international organizations, takes part in academic and network projects, and is also a member of a number of international associations.

The goal of BSU’s international activities is to strengthen educational ties, develop academic mobility of students and teachers, implement joint scientific research and promote the university brand in the international arena.
